name: Aisle Wedding
description: Aisle is the AI-powered destination wedding platform. Connect Aisle to Claude to manage your guest list, track RSVPs and dietary restrictions, browse and compare destination wedding venues worldwide, find local vendors, manage your event schedule, view accommodations, check your registry, estimate budgets by destination, get personalized packing lists, and access a library of planning guides. Couples can ask Claude questions like "who hasn't RSVP'd yet?" or "find castle venues in Italy for 80 guests" and get instant, actionable answers from their live wedding data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aisle Wedding to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aisle Wedding to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://aisle.wedding/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aisle Wedding MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aisle Wedding lists 22 MCP tools, including get_my_wedding, get_my_wedding_stats, update_my_wedding, list_my_guests, add_my_guest, update_my_guest, remove_my_guest, list_my_events, add_my_event, remove_my_event, list_my_accommodations, and list_my_registry.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aisle Wedding?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aisle Wedding in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.

_published_faq.name: Does Aisle Wedding MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aisle Wedding requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aisle Wedding is developed by Aisle Life. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
